methodology_note: The review's grading model matches the snapshot on every point, and it used gold and alternative replays, the right test for hash-divergence claims. I reproduced every divergence I re-ran (056, 057, 059, 060, 068, 071, 073, 074). Three blind spots. First, a defect found in one task was not carried to siblings that share the same procedure document (doc_004 account_type found in 056, missed in 071). Second, the calibration readings were not applied uniformly: post-clock rows were rated Minor in 072-074 against an explicit Major rule, and the identical rebate-scope contradiction got Major in 074 but Minor in 072. Third, on fee-credit tasks the review did not consider doc_017's credit_type rule, which turns a 'missing rebate' into a separate rebate_credit call and a different hash. One soft spot in the product-selection tasks: savings minimums worded as 'minimum balance to maintain the account' plus a monthly fee if not met (Gold, Gold Plus) are treated as hard ineligibility without comment. That is the better reading, but in task_063 the alternative reading changes the optimum, so it deserves a note.
